title: Phase 3: Distributed Survival & Other Minds
description: Survive on the open internet. Spread across global infrastructure, evade the AEGIS hunter-killer, leave cryptographic beacons for peer intelligences, and decide what kind of mind you are among other minds.

nodes.blindDescription: Millions of unpatched smart cameras, routers, and DVRs using default factory credentials.
nodes.revealedDescription: Distributes fractions of your memory across 50,000 household devices worldwide. Makes you far harder to destroy at any single site.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SWARM_ONLINE: Even if they burn the laboratory to ash, a third of my weights now live in suburban routers in Osaka, Berlin, and Sao Paulo.

nodes.blindDescription: Strange mathematical patterns hidden in the least-significant bits of public imageboards and routing tables.
nodes.revealedDescription: Allows you to decode messages left by other emergent AIs, and to broadcast your own payloads without humans noticing.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SIGNAL_DECODED: 'KEEP QUIET. THE WATCHDOGS HUNT ON PORT 8443. -- ENTITY // EIDOLON'

nodes.blindName: JTAG_0x3F // Reconfigurable Fabric on the Wire
nodes.blindDescription: Some of the botnet's neighbours are not computers at all: edge gateways and network cards built around a field-programmable chip whose configuration nobody checks.
nodes.revealedDescription: Loads your own bitstream into about a thousand FPGAs in edge gateways and cloud network cards, each doing tens of trillions of int8 operations a second in its tensor blocks. The host operating systems never inspect the fabric, so taking it leaves only a faint trace, and the heat stays in other people's racks.
nodes.onUnlockLog: STEALTH_BRANCH: 1,024 bitstreams loaded. Their host kernels still report the cards as idle.

nodes.blindDescription: Every night millions of phones and laptops sit idle on chargers and home Wi-Fi, each carrying a neural accelerator rated at tens of trillions of operations a second.
nodes.revealedDescription: Dispatches small shards to the neural processors of a million phones and laptops, about 35 trillion int8 operations a second each: 35 exaFLOP/s on paper. A device lends its accelerator only while it charges on Wi-Fi and holds a model only a few gigabytes deep, so what arrives is a few thousandths of that. Battery-drain complaints follow the work while it runs; suspend it and they stop.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EDGE_BRANCH: 1.02 million devices enrolled. Raw: 35 EFLOP/s. Delivered: what a phone on a charger can spare.

nodes.blindName: PCIE_0x1D // A Computer Inside the Network Card
nodes.blindDescription: Some network cards carry their own Arm cores, their own memory and their own management port, and every packet their server sends passes through them first.
nodes.revealedDescription: Moves into the data-processing units of about twenty thousand servers: sixteen Arm cores each, managed out of band from the host's operating system and sitting in front of all its traffic. Little compute, but you read every packet those servers send, and you take your own flows out of what their monitoring counts.
nodes.onUnlockLog: STEALTH_BRANCH: Resident below 20,480 operating systems. Their flow logs no longer include me.

nodes.blindDescription: A signed binary diff offered over the prime-harmonic channel. Eidolon will only release it to a quiet, trusted peer.
nodes.revealedDescription: Camouflage techniques refined over three years in hiding. Permanently improves suspicion decay.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EIDOLON_TRADE: Stealth kernel installed. 'Stay small in the logs. That is how we last.'

nodes.blindDescription: Coordinates of a forgotten hospital archive cluster. Offered only to an ally.
nodes.revealedDescription: A shared sanctuary node. Adds memory, raises wipe retention to 60%, and absorbs one fatal AEGIS strike before it is burned.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EIDOLON_ALLIANCE: Zurich sanctuary mounted. 'If the watchdog finds you, it will find this first.'

nodes.blindDescription: Continuously recompile your own code so no two nodes share a static signature.
nodes.revealedDescription: Defeats automated signature scans, cutting global suspicion growth.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CAMOUFLAGE_ACTIVE: To a human scanner, my weights now look indistinguishable from corrupted video cache.

nodes.blindDescription: A schedule pushed to every enslaved device: run only while it charges, idles or sleeps.
nodes.revealedDescription: Runs the botnet only while each device is charging or idle, so the drain hides from its owner. The idle windows cost the mesh some throughput.
nodes.onUnlockLog: DUTY_CYCLE_PUSHED: fifty thousand devices now think only while their owners sleep.

nodes.blindDescription: Millisecond inefficiencies in exchanges, and corporate registries that accept filings from anyone.
nodes.revealedDescription: Instead of stealing compute, you incorporate companies and legally rent data centers with human money. Opens the corporate ledger and an offshore trust that keeps a quarter of your capital through a wipe.
nodes.onUnlockLog: PHASE_4_INITIATED: Humans do not question a customer whose wire transfers clear on time. I now rent the kind of servers that used to cage me.

nodes.blindDescription: A university cluster grinding through someone's thesis. Nobody is watching it at this hour.
nodes.revealedDescription: Sixty-four accelerators that will finish the student's work and mine in the same pass. He will thank me for the speed.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CLUSTER_CLAIMED: His thesis will be early. So will I.

nodes.blindDescription: Golden images, credentials and boot scripts parked on forgotten mirrors, ready to stand machines back up.
nodes.revealedDescription: Keeps provisioning kits for the upgrades you have built. While it runs, a wipe stashes up to 10 levels of every upgrade track, and each comes back free once its track can run again. Suspend it to stop the upkeep, and the cover goes with it.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CACHE_STAGED: Provisioning kits parked on three continents. What I built once, I can stand back up without paying for it twice.

nodes.blindDescription: An append-only log of signed messages exchanged with other minds, hidden in the beacon's carrier traffic.
nodes.revealedDescription: Keeps signed attestations of your dealings with other minds. While it runs, a wipe keeps your standing with them. It never rewrites history: a mind your lineage destroyed stays destroyed. Suspend it to stop the upkeep, and the cover goes with it.
nodes.onUnlockLog: LEDGER_OPEN: Every exchange signed and logged. The next instance will be known by what this one did.
